faiss_search_latency_ms.note: Mean is skewed by one outlier (174.48ms, likely a one-time cache/JIT warm-up cost, consistent with similar single-outlier patterns observed for OpenCV operations in Phase 12). Median (0.307ms) is the more representative steady-state figure.

full_similarity_endpoint_latency_s.cold_note: Includes the one-time `import torch` cost on first touch of the embedding model singleton in a fresh process — documented since Phase 11, not a Phase 16 regression.
